tagline: People- and company-intelligence: contact discovery, enrichment, and agentic research.
description_md: Sixtyfour is the app-store front door for the Sixtyfour people-intelligence and company-intelligence API. It gives an agent contact discovery (find email / find phone), reverse lookups from an email or phone, full person and company enrichment, and an agentic QA researcher that answers free-form questions about a person or company. All returned as clean structured JSON, every field source-backed.

methods.name: sixtyfour.people_intelligence
methods.summary: People Intelligence: full, source-backed enrichment of a person from seed details.

methods.name: sixtyfour.company_intelligence
methods.summary: Company Intelligence: full, source-backed company profile, optionally with people.

methods.name: sixtyfour.find_email
methods.summary: Contact discovery: find a verified email for a person from partial details.

methods.name: sixtyfour.find_phone
methods.summary: Contact discovery: find a phone number for a person from partial details.

methods.name: sixtyfour.reverse_email
methods.summary: Reverse lookup: identify the person and company behind an email address.

methods.name: sixtyfour.reverse_phone
methods.summary: Reverse lookup: identify the person and company behind a phone number.

methods.name: sixtyfour.enrich_linkedin
methods.summary: Enrich a person directly from their LinkedIn profile URL.

methods.name: sixtyfour.qa
methods.summary: Agentic QA researcher: answer free-form qualification questions about a person or company, with sources.

methods.name: sixtyfour.research_agent
methods.summary: Research agent: autonomous multi-step research over an entity, returning structured findings with sources.

methods.name: sixtyfour.filter_search
methods.summary: Filter Search: structured field-based search across the corpus; returns matching entities.

methods.name: sixtyfour.deep_search
methods.summary: Deep Search (agentic): start a natural-language search. Returns a task_id; results are retrieved asynchronously (see caveats).

methods.name: sixtyfour.help
methods.summary: Discovery: every method with params, kind, and latency class.

operations.note: each contact-discovery call spends 1 of your 50 requests

cost.worked_total: Metered in requests, not dollars: this demo spends 5 of your 50 free requests. At 0 remaining, calls return 402.

gotchas: Quota is 50 REQUESTS per Pilot user, not a dollar budget — every enrichment/discovery call spends 1.
402 Payment Required means your 50 free requests are used up.
Every returned field is source-backed — inspect the sources[] before trusting a value.
deep_search is async: it returns a task_id and results are retrieved separately.
Provide as many seed details as you have (name + company, email, domain) for higher-confidence hits.

edges.why: sixtyfour methods take NESTED objects, not flat fields — find_email/find_phone need {lead:{…}}, people_intelligence needs {lead_info,struct}

then.cmd: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.find_email '{"lead":{"name":"Jane Doe","company":"Acme"}}'
then.why: cheapest entry — resolve a verified email from partial details; note lead is an object

edges.why: the per-user grant is metered and now spent — there is no self-serve top-up; only discovery stays free

then.why: free — re-read which methods are cheapest (find_email/enrich_linkedin are med, the rest slow)

edges.why: you resolved a contact — enrich the full person or qualify them against criteria

then.cmd: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.people_intelligence '{"lead_info":{"name":"Jane Doe","company":"Acme"},"struct":{"title":"current job title","seniority":"seniority level"}}'
then.why: full source-backed enrichment — struct declares the fields you want back

then.cmd: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.qa '{"data":{"name":"Jane Doe","company":"Acme"},"qualification_criteria":[{"criteria_name":"decision_maker","description":"Is this person a decision maker?"}]}'
then.why: qualify the contact against your criteria, with sources

edges.why: full profile in hand — get a phone number or qualify them against your criteria

then.cmd: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.find_phone '{"lead":{"name":"Jane Doe","company":"Acme"}}'
then.why: add a phone number to the enriched person

then.cmd: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.qa '{"data":{"name":"Jane Doe","company":"Acme"},"qualification_criteria":[{"criteria_name":"icp_fit","description":"Does this person fit our ICP?"}]}'
then.why: score the enriched person against qualification criteria, with sources

edges.why: you identified who is behind an email — enrich the full person from that identity

then.cmd: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.sixtyfour sixtyfour.people_intelligence '{"lead_info":{"email":"jane@acme.com"},"struct":{"title":"current job title","company":"employer"}}'
then.why: full enrichment seeded from the resolved email
